== Title ==
<span lang="ja">キャベル中尉</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に２を加える。艦がタイラントなら装甲値にも１を加える。帝国軍のリーダーとともに戦闘する場合、相手の戦闘運命数の合計から１を引く。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">カリダの士官学校を卒業したばかり。タイラントの一等航海士。野心的で冷酷かつ有能。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Lieutenant Cabbel.

'''Lore''' — A recent graduate of the officers’ school on Carida. First officer of the Tyrant. Ambitious, ruthless, and able.

'''Game text''' — Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If that ship is Tyrant, also add 1 to armor. When in battle with an Imperial leader, subtract 1 from the opponent’s total battle destiny.

The Japanese face names the ship as Tyrant for the armor bonus. The English face says On Tyrant. Both print the power and battle-destiny modifiers.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-lieutenantcabbel-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Lieutenant Cabbel]].</ref>
